meta.name: high-end-visual-design
meta.description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页设计拥有高端品牌质感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让AI生成的设计摆脱廉价感、更像专业工作室出品。
copy.tagline_en: Make web designs feel premium and agency-crafted
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI-generated designs to look expensive and professional.

howto.what: Claude 写网页界面时会套用一套高端设计规范:指定字体、加宽留白、卡片用双层嵌框结构、动效走自定义曲线,并避开 Inter、Roboto 等默认项,输出 React/Tailwind/HTML 代码。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 设计网站、界面或生成前端页面代码时接管;它还会在几套视觉与版式原型里换着组合,避免连续产出同一种风格。

say.text: 帮我做一个 AI 产品落地页,要有高端 agency 的质感。
say.note: 它会先选一套视觉与版式原型再动手。

say.text: 给这个页面加上带弹簧感的滚动入场动效和按钮悬停反馈。
say.note: 会注入自定义 cubic-bezier 过渡与错峰入场。

say.text: 把这几张卡片改成双层嵌框结构,圆角用 rounded-[2rem]。
say.note: 外层壳加内层内容区,圆角按同心计算。

howto.what_en: When writing UI, Claude follows a high-end design spec: set fonts, wide whitespace, double-bezel card nesting, custom motion curves, avoiding Inter/Roboto-style defaults — output as React/Tailwind/HTML.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to design a website or interface, or generate front-end page code. It also rotates among several vibe and layout archetypes so no two outputs look alike.

say_en.text: Build an AI product landing page with a high-end agency feel.
say_en.note: It picks a vibe and layout archetype first.

say_en.text: Add spring-like scroll entrance animations and magnetic button hover to this page.
say_en.note: It injects custom cubic-bezier transitions and staggered reveals.

say_en.text: Rebuild these cards as double-bezel nested containers with rounded-[2rem].
say_en.note: Outer shell plus inner core, with concentric radii.
